summary: Issue: Whether reserved category candidates with higher marks than general category candidates must be adjusted in the general category pool. Standard: Interpretation of reservation policy under Articles 14 and 16. Reasoning: Reliance on Indra Sawhney and R.K. Sabharwal to hold that meritorious reserved candidates must be considered for general category vacancies, allowing subsequent reserved candidates to be promoted. Outcome: Appeal dismissed; Tribunal and High Court rulings upheld.
legal_provisions_cited: Articles 14 and 16 of the Constitution of India
Indra Sawhney Vs. Union of India, 1992 Supp (3) SCC 217
R.K. Sabharwal Vs. State of Punjab, (2007) 8 SCC 785
Union of India Vs. Ramesh Ram, (2010) 7 SCC 234
